_comment: Roll-up print formats as the shops' own data sheets state them. These are facts about a
product, not about an app, which is why they live in the engine: an app's roll-up config names
one by key. Lengths in millimetres. `trim_mm` is the Endformat (width, height) including the
strips that are printed but hidden in the display; `hidden_mm` says which; `bleed_mm` is the
Beschnitt added around the Endformat; `safe_mm` is the Sicherheitsabstand from the visible edge.
A shop not listed here gets an entry here, from its data sheet, with the URL and the date read.
Never reuse one shop's file for another: the data formats are not interchangeable.

wirmachendruck-premium-85x200._note: Datenformat 856 x 2186 = 3 Beschnitt + 10 hidden under the top rail + 2000 visible + 170 hidden in the cassette + 3 Beschnitt. RGB is converted to CMYK by the shop. The sheet asks 300 dpi for images in general; roll-up practice and the other shops ask 100-150.

flyeralarm-classic-85x200._note: Datenformat 870 x 2270 = 10 Beschnitt + 10 hidden under the rail + 1990 visible + 250 hidden in the cassette + 10 Beschnitt; the sheet's 2000 mm dimension includes the 10 mm rail strip. Profile ISO Coated v2 (FOGRA39), 100-150 dpi for large format.
